note: St. Landry Parish has no queryable zoning district service. The parish GIS viewer (Assessor, stlandrymapping.azurewebsites.net) exposes only parcels, with zoning fields almost entirely unpopulated, and no ArcGIS REST services are listed. The City of Opelousas publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (City-of-Opelousas-Zoning-Maps.pdf). No ArcGIS zoning layer for Eunice, Sunset or Port Barre turned up in searches.
